items.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: But when I used to sit in with Lionel Hampton’s band, he said to me one night

ctx.x: Did you like working with Benny?

I liked working with Benny a lot because I loved, he was playing great at that time and I got along with Benny, who was hard to get along with, everybody knows that. Most people know that and don’t know what instrument he played. But when I used to sit in with Lionel Hampton’s band, he said to me one night “I hear you’re going with the old man.” I said “yeah I’m going to go to Europe with Benny.” I was 21. And here’s what he said to me. He said “now if he gets weird on you, get weirder.” I said “this is the key?”…
